title: Zone-Map Pruning Stats

title: B-Tree Secondary Index

title: Columnar Nested-Loop Join

title: Zero-copy JSON tokenizer and parser

title: WAL streaming shipper

title: Tiered WAL archiver

title: Columnar CSV Scan Engine

title: Window Function Runtime

title: WAL compaction daemon

title: Fuzzy checkpoint engine

title: Vectorized Volcano Executor
blurb: Pull-based iterator model with batch-friendly operators, runtime-adaptive batch sizing, and selective late materialization.

title: Cost Model with Histograms

title: Packrat PEG parser combinator

title: MVCC transactions over WAL

title: Encrypted WAL with key rotation

title: AST-Based Query Planner

title: Hash Join Probe Engine

title: Streaming Aggregation Engine
blurb: Incremental grouped aggregation with retracts, state tiers (hashmap/rocks-like/overflow), and exactly-once checkpoints.

title: JIT Expression Compiler
blurb: Compiles typed arithmetic/predicate expressions to a tiny stack IR and emits machine code via a portable codegen backend.

title: DAG-Scheduled Volcano Engine
blurb: Executor that breaks pipelined barriers, parallelizes independent fragments, and applies morsel-driven scheduling.

title: WAL-backed B+tree page store
blurb: Page-oriented B+tree with write-ahead logging, including page split/merge and LSN-pinned recovery.

title: LSM tree with WAL and SSTable compaction
blurb: Memtable + WAL flush to immutable SSTables, leveled compaction, and crash-safe manifest replay.

title: Copy-on-write log-structured store
blurb: Append-only WAL feeding immutable segments with root pointer indirection and snapshot reads.

title: Group-commit WAL with fsync batching

title: Compressed WAL with frame dictionary

title: Direct-IO WAL with aligned appender

title: WAL record codec with schema versioning

blurb: In-process counters and histograms for fsync latency, backlog, and replay progress with periodic dumps.

title: Stream-to-batch windowed aggregation

title: SLR(1) table generator

title: Earley chart parser

title: CYK recognizer over CNF

title: TOML 1.0 spec-compliant parser

title: Tiered cache with warm-up daemon

title: Write-back coalescing cache

title: ARC with hierarchical token buckets
blurb: ARC policy combined with token-bucket admission for QoS-aware backends and burst smoothing.

title: Negative-result / tombstone cache
